structuredIncident.summary:
At approximately 10:00 AM on May 20, 2024 (Turn 2), a two-person Utilities crew (U-A/U-B) was preparing the #1 slab caster dryer system for maintenance in the RHOB process area. They reported an instrument-air pressure loss and paused work until supply restored at ~10:07 AM. No injuries occurred.

The incident description does not establish whether the interruption originated upstream, downstream, or within the distribution network; this remains unknown based on current evidence.
structuredIncident.focalEvent: Loss of instrument air pressure in RHOB area during maintenance preparation
structuredIncident.actualImpact: Work paused for approximately 7 minutes. No injuries reported.
structuredIncident.potentialImpact: Potential hazard to personnel or equipment if the interruption had persisted, but no specific downstream consequences are documented yet.
structuredIncident.normalState: Utilities air gallery serves RHOB process area; local indication P-R at RHOB service station normally shows normal pressure band (per shift log).
structuredIncident.eventState: At ~10:00 AM, local controls showed supply complaints and an 'air-low' indication appeared. At ~10:07 AM, the indication returned to normal.
